parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. The value of this parameter must be the same as the application name in the ingest URL. Otherwise, the configuration does not take effect. If you want to match all applications, specify an asterisk (\*) as the value.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the index file. TS segments that are uploaded before the end time are included in the index file. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: EndTimeIncluded
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include the end time. If you set this parameter to true, the system attempts to include one more TS segment. The created index file covers the entire time range that is specified by the StartTime and EndTime parameters.

parameters.name: OssBucket
parameters.description: The name of the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: OssEndpoint
parameters.description: The endpoint of the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: OssObject
parameters.description: The name of the recording that is stored in OSS.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the index file. TS segments that are uploaded after the start time are included in the index file. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. The value of this parameter must be the same as the stream name in the ingest URL. Otherwise, the configuration does not take effect. If you want to match all streams, specify an asterisk (\*) as the value.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-live-stream-record-index-files --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --oss-endpoint cn-oss-0000.aliyuncs.com --oss-bucket liveBucket0000 --oss-object AppName_/_StreamName_/_Date_/_Hour_/_Minute_Second_.m3u8 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --end-time-included false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live CreateLiveStreamRecordIndexFiles --region cn-hangzhou --EndTimeIncluded false --StreamName liveStream0000 --OssEndpoint 'cn-oss-0000.aliyuncs.com' --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --OssBucket liveBucket0000 --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --OssObject 'AppName_/_StreamName_/_Date_/_Hour_/_Minute_Second_.m3u8' --AppName liveApp0000
